title: Replicas, lag and read routing
brief: Route reads from the freshness and failure promises each copy can meet.
outcomes: Distinguish received, durable and replayed progress
Design read-your-write routing and account for lag and retention
entry: Commit durability and application request identity.

title: Restoring PostgreSQL to a recovery target
brief: Restore a PostgreSQL cluster to a verified target and account for the work outside that history.
outcomes: Build and test a base-backup and archived-WAL chain
Verify a target and reconcile later valid effects safely
entry: General backup reasoning and PostgreSQL WAL.

title: PostgreSQL schema changes under load
brief: Carry out compatible PostgreSQL schema and index changes with bounded waits and complete acceptance.
outcomes: Choose native operations from their lock and rewrite behaviour
Validate backfill convergence and maintain indexes safely
entry: General schema-change protocol, PostgreSQL indexes and locking.

title: CockroachDB isolation and follower reads
brief: Choose CockroachDB current and historical reads from the decision they must support.
outcomes: Distinguish Serializable, Read Committed and historical observation
Explain safe follower reads and their retention/freshness limits
entry: General snapshots, distributed time and CockroachDB transactions.

neighbours.RL127: Owns GLOBAL and regional table placement.

title: CockroachDB query work and hot ranges
brief: Reduce CockroachDB SQL and KV work without hiding a contention bottleneck.
outcomes: Locate lookups, fan-out, network work and contention
Weigh covering or distributed keys against write and ordering cost
entry: General plans, CockroachDB ranges and index contracts.

title: CockroachDB table locality and region survival
brief: Configure CockroachDB table locality and survival goals from actual access and failure requirements.
outcomes: Match regional-by-table, regional-by-row and GLOBAL tables to requests
Verify placement and survival without inventing regional timing evidence
entry: General regional placement, CockroachDB ranges and read contracts.

title: Operating and securing a CockroachDB cluster
brief: Operate a secure CockroachDB cluster with evidence about identity, range health and planned removal.
outcomes: Verify secure runtime identity, least privilege and tenant isolation
Diagnose under-replication and remove a node without losing the survival budget
entry: For security: general least privilege and trusted application/tenant ownership (RL104); the needed secure deployment and SQL object/session context is introduced locally. For node health/removal: also CockroachDB ranges (RL123), general rebalancing and the topology’s survival budget (RL109).

neighbours.RL123: Supplies range, lease and replica understanding before node health/removal work.
neighbours.RL109: Supplies movement and failure-headroom understanding before node health/removal work.

title: CockroachDB backup and recovery
brief: Restore a CockroachDB history and reconcile a later valid booking without consuming capacity twice.
outcomes: Validate full/incremental backup coverage and restore scope
Close source writes and reconcile booking identity, capacity and external effects
entry: General recovery and fenced reconciliation, the class booking invariant and CockroachDB transactions.

neighbours.RL96: Owns the closed-history reconciliation and acceptance contract.
